name: @cane-runtime/cane-ts
description: Independent TypeScript runtimes for Cane assets and JavaScript rendering engines.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @cane-runtime/layaair-3.4.1 verify:sdk && pnpm --filter @cane-runtime/cocos-3.8.8 verify:sdk && tsc -b && pnpm --filter @cane-runtime/pixi-v8 bundle:iife && pnpm --filter @cane-runtime/layaair-3.4.1 bundle:iife
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @cane-runtime/layaair-3.4.1 verify:sdk && pnpm --filter @cane-runtime/cocos-3.8.8 verify:sdk && tsc -b --pretty false
